items.source:
Interface to be implemented by Spring AOP Advisors wrapping AspectJ
aspects that may have a lazy initialization strategy. For example,
a perThis instantiation model would mean lazy initialization of the advice.
items.translation: 由 Spring AOP Advisor 实现的接口，用于包装可能具有延迟初始化策略的 AspectJ 切面。例如，perThis 实例化模型意味着建议（advice）的延迟初始化。

items.source: Return whether this advisor has already instantiated its advice.
items.translation: 返回该顾问是否已经实例化其建议。

items.source: Return whether this advisor is lazily initializing its underlying advice.
items.translation: 返回该顾问是否懒加载其底层建议。
